content:
Liam B: Hi all  newbie question: I started Tue 4/11 and there9s a company holiday on Fri 4/22. Do I get holiday pay if I started this week? Also my relocation parking receipt is on my personal card  can that be reimbursed before my first paycheck?
People Ops: Welcome Liam! :wave: Short answers: holiday pay depends on whether your hire processed before payroll cutoff for that pay run. Reimbursement yes, we can do an off-cycle or issue a virtual Ramp card.
Finance Sam: Payroll detail: cutoff for that run is typically the Friday 5pm PT a week before payroll. If your hire paperwork and direct deposit were entered before that cutoff you'll be included. If not, holiday pay will show in the next cycle. PTO accrual starts immediately but first paystub shows prorated amount.
Liam B: Thanks. How do I request the off-cycle? I need the parking reimbursement this week.
Benefits Bot: For reimbursable onboarding/moving expenses: 1) File an expense in Concur and tag "onboarding-relocation". 2) Email ops@redwood.com with the Concur link, attach receipts, and cc your manager. In the email subject put "Off-cycle reimbursement - new hire".
Finance Sam: Once ops has the Concur link + manager approval we can route for off-cycle payment. Typical turnaround after approvals is 2-4 business days; if urgent we can issue a virtual Ramp card instead which can be created same day after approval.
Kendra M: Welcome! FYI I had the same issue during onboarding. Ramp virtual card saved me a bunch of back-and-forth. If you want, I can loop my manager on approvals to speed things up.
Liam B: I'll file Concur now and email ops. One more q: I enrolled in benefits during onboarding  is coverage effective on my start date or next month?
People Ops: Coverage effective date depends on carrier feed. If you completed enrollment during onboarding it often is effective on your start date; if enrollment was delayed it might start on the 1st of next month. Email benefits@redwood.com with your confirmation number from the benefits portal if you want us to escalate.
Liam B: Got it. Sending the Concur + ops email now and will follow up if carrier says otherwise. Thanks for the fast help :pray:
People Ops: Checklist for Liam: 1) Confirm W-4 + direct deposit are in payroll portal 2) Submit Concur expense + email ops@redwood.com to request off-cycle OR request virtual Ramp card 3) If dependent/benefits questions, email benefits@redwood.com. We'll update this thread once payroll confirms cutoff for the holiday run.
Liam B: Appreciate it everyone! :tada:
